svg.desc: The repo has 211 skills, 11 agents you pick, 10 helper agents, 11 MCP servers and 126 plugin skills. Groups and the agents they bring: default (55 skills · 8 MCP): build, plan, design, security, 3d-modeling, second-opinion, local-model; work (43 skills · 7 MCP): security, second-opinion, local-model; ai_research (99 skills): ai-research; career (31 skills): career; fcos_app_installer (8 skills): fcos-app-installer; reverse_engineering (11 skills · 3 MCP): reverse-engineering.
